gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-jp: Tall lowercase and curves that sweep open give this body a modern, businesslike read. Noto Sans JP would carry a long passage smoothly, while Goldman's wide, parenthesis-round letters handle the bold announcing above it.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Wide, bold, a bit stage-lit. Goldman's round letters take the commanding role, and Noto Sans Kaithi follows with lowercase that fills the line like capitals, contemporary and unfussy beneath it.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Goldman spreads out wide and loud, its lowercase towering over the capitals like a shouted sign. Noto Sans Kannada is the friendlier voice, with gentle capitals and generously opened s curves.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Goldman does the commanding, stretching its round, parenthesis-like letters wide across the top of the page. Noto Sans Kayah Li does the tidy, clean reading below, brush ends lifted away before each curve closes.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Approachable is the first word for the body here, with curves that never close back on themselves. Yet Goldman's wide-set, parenthesis-round forms give the pair its real force, bold up top and dense with dark lowercase below.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Goldman stretches out wide and bold, its big lowercase looming over its capitals like a billboard. Noto Sans Khmer then reads cleanly, its proud small letters and chisel-notch openings easy on the eye.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Wide, bold and a touch theatrical. Goldman leads with its parenthesis-round letters, and Noto Sans Khojki settles into a modern, clean read, with e eyes large enough and exits open enough to let light through.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Big, wide, and unmistakably in charge. Goldman is built to command with its tall lowercase and round forms, while Noto Sans Khudawadi is built to be read, its low capital height and unsealed rounds feeling clean and approachable.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-kr: Commanding is how Goldman lands, wide and bold. Shrink that heading down and its generous spacing starts to feel lost, whereas Noto Sans KR keeps stubby ascenders and open curves tidy beside its big x-height.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-lao: Modern through and through, this pair starts with Goldman's wide, bold, parenthesis-round letters in charge of the top. Noto Sans Lao handles the quieter work, its lifted x-height and open mouths on c, e and a carrying the reading.
